status: draft-for-author-review; no production or casting approval implied
scope: Six named NPCs; documentation only. No runtime, audio, ledger or Q90 modifications.
rules: Exactly one author-selected speaker per NPC. Null voice_uuid means casting hold; candidate_voice_uuid is never a generation target.
Only new-draft rows contain generation_input. Reuse rows require listening QC; Q90 references use the existing Q90 generation order, not a second job.
Canonical transcript for new drafts means proposed exact words, not an approved or recorded transcript. Reuse catalog transcripts remain unconfirmed until listening.
One variant per situation is the minimum (within requested 1–3); Mark has an optional second greeting. Rain/storm/snow alternatives are optional; neutral shelter is sufficient.
Hungry/exhausted cover their real need/pause events. There is no separate general work-interrupted recording.
No ordinary family/resource/activity answers. No generic material-reward claim.
After selecting an uncast NPC's speaker, suppress drafts covered by same-speaker QC-passed audio or approved Q90. Never borrow another speaker.

farewell: src/ui-vue/store.ts:closeNpcDialogueMenu, no pending offer decline. Ordinary conversation close.
attention: src/ai/NpcAgent.ts:playReactionSound normal reaction tier; admitted proximity reaction.
thanks: Semantic intent exists, but no general thanks producer verified. Bind only to a committed helpful act, not an attempted action.
refusal: Semantic intent exists; no general refusal voice producer verified. Bind to an actual refused request.
confirmation: Agreement maps to confirmation. Semantic intent exists; exact successful agreement voice binding absent.
quest_offer: Quest offers exist as text; QuestVoiceIntent admits quest_offer but no inspected producer requests it. Require actual available offer by this giver.
quest_accepted: src/ui-vue/store.ts:acceptNpcDialogueOffer after onAccept. Acknowledges willingness, not task completion or guaranteed success.
quest_declined: src/ui-vue/store.ts:closeNpcDialogueMenu with pending helpResult.offer. Decline, not generic farewell.
quest_complete: src/quests/QuestManager.ts:playQuestCompleteSound via complete outcome, loaded giver resolved in createApp. Generic thanks only; no victory, restored animal, reward or completed repair claim.
hungry: src/ai/NpcAgent.ts:choose selects food need after previousNeed != food. Does NOT establish work was interrupted, an empty stomach, food available or consumption.
exhausted: src/ai/NpcAgent.ts:goTo/execute -> exhausted on isExhausted(stamina); action pauses. Rest, not end of day.
weather_shelter: src/ai/NpcAgent.ts:beginSeekShelter before arrival. Neutral shared variant for rain/storm/snow through npcBarkRequest.weatherShelterVoiceIntents.
weather_shelter_rain: beginSeekShelter with weather rain; storm may also use rain fallback under existing policy. No forecast/intensity/arrival claim.
weather_shelter_storm: beginSeekShelter with current weather storm only. No inferred damage/lightning strike.
weather_shelter_snow: beginSeekShelter with current weather snow only. Never rain fallback.
danger_alert: NpcAgent newly perceived animal-threat episode. Species-neutral; no death, victory or all-clear claim.
combat_start: NpcAgent successful beginCombat. Do not use on mere sighting or flight; no assumed weapon.
work_finished: NpcAgent terminal execute with classifyPendingActivity(action, activeNeed) === work. One task ended; no end-of-shift, tools-away or repaired-world claim.
guard_response: NpcAgent successful guard threat intervention; not mere profession or greeting.
livestock_danger: NpcAgent flockThreatApplied with household at new threat episode. npcBarkRequest can reuse same-speaker danger_alert.
trade_open: NpcDialogueMenu.vue:openTrade -> onOpenTrade is a real action, without specific voice hook. Require successful opening for this trader; no stock promise.
trade_close: Trade-close-specific NPC voice hook not verified. Close with or without purchase; never imply a completed sale.
reward_ack: Quest-complete voice receives only giverNpcId and intent, no quest/outcome/reward receipt. Add exact binding only after actual reward grant success; never generic quest_complete.
story: Existing authored quest text surface, but no quest/stage-specific audio selector. Require exact quest, speaker and stage/outcome.
